issues.where: Intro paragraph (Thursday, San Miguel County Planning Commission)
issues.quote: a county-initiated rezoning of a portion of Placerville Park near the fire station
issues.problem: The intro describes a second Planning Commission agenda item — a rezoning of Placerville Park — that does not appear anywhere in the body listing for that meeting, so readers cannot find it.
issues.suggestion: Either add the Placerville Park rezoning item to the Planning Commission body listing, or remove the reference from the intro.
issues.resolution: not an error: the rezoning is on the posted Nov 12 agenda (legal notice in the Telluride Times, Nov 5); the card shows the first ~520 characters of the summary by design and links to the agenda

issues.where: THU, NOV 12 · SMART Board of Directors listing
issues.quote:
The agenda hasn't been posted yet — details will follow closer to the meeting.
ℹ Why This Matters
The gondola (built 1996) is important regional infrastructure.
issues.problem: The 'Why This Matters' gondola blurb is inserted inside the SMART Board listing, between the 'no agenda' text and the '📅 Add to calendar' link, making it appear the calendar link belongs to the gondola item rather than the SMART Board meeting.
issues.suggestion: Move the 'Why This Matters' block outside the SMART Board listing, either above or below it, so the calendar link unambiguously belongs to the SMART meeting.
issues.resolution: not an error: by design — the gondola 'Why This Matters' callout applies to SMART's own meetings (Morgan 2026-10-19) and every highlighted card puts the callout above its action links, same as Gov-Hub
